Info

Factory service constructing StreamLoopRunner with injected collaborators.

class scarajectory.infrastructure.worker.ascii.stream_loop_runner_factory.StreamLoopRunnerFactory[source]¶

Bases: object

Factory providing creation of StreamLoopRunner instances.

It defines:

methods:
create - Constructs StreamLoopRunner with default formatter.
create_with_formatter - Constructs runner with formatter.
create_with_collaborators - Constructs runner with delegates.
get_version - Returns factory version string.

Constructs and returns a configured StreamLoopRunner instance.

Parameters:

  • pacing_bundle – FlowPacingBundle holding pacing and barrier.

  • command_sender – Sender transmitting raw command packets.

  • state_controller – Controller managing streaming state.

  • observer_dispatcher – Dispatcher emitting progress and logs.

  • pacing_config – Pacing configuration with delays.

Returns:

Configured StreamLoopRunner instance.

Exceptions:

None.
